a0_vote_mimicry_control.note: LATENT_PROBE is an OUT-OF-FOLD leave-one-task-out PCA-basis + balanced logistic probe; the held-out task's gold labels and latents never train its own probe/basis. residual regresses the probe on vote-count globally and ranks by the residual -- if it does not beat vote, the latent's lift is vote-collinear, not orthogonal model-native signal.

corrigendum_2026_06_09.discrimination_gate_correction: gates.discrimination_within_task_auroc_gt_0p70=True is based on a macro-AUROC inflated by 84.6% one-vote junk negatives. Hard-negative variants: pair-weighted 0.7815; top-10-by-vote negatives 0.7948; votes>=5 negatives 0.6646 (FAILS the 0.70 gate). The gate as originally defined passes; the hard-negative variant does not — record both.
corrigendum_2026_06_09.framing_correction: The 'signal exists but does not convert' reading over-credits the latent. Vote's own within-task AUROC is 0.9235 > probe 0.8689, and the vote-orthogonal probe residual has AUROC 0.3176 (below chance) — the latent carries NO incremental gold signal beyond vote; it is a partial vote shadow, not an independent signal that fails to convert.
corrigendum_2026_06_09.loto_caveat: The split is leave-one-ENTRY-out; task f3e62deb contributes two test entries that sit in each other's training folds (direction favors the probe). Strict task-grouped LOTO reproduces identical probe numbers (pass@2=0.4194) — immaterial here, but use grouped LOTO at 400-task scale.
corrigendum_2026_06_09.origin: 5-reviewer adversarial-verify round (workflow gap3-stage1-adversarial-verify). All original numbers above reproduce exactly (probe column re-fits from raw z_mean to max|diff|=5.1e-7). The corrections below sharpen interpretation; the headline verdict is UNCHANGED.
corrigendum_2026_06_09.residual_control_caveat: The global-OLS vote-residualization is mildly anti-vote (pearson(votes,probe)=-0.227 slope tilt). Fairer variants: within-task vote-rank residual pass@2=0.1613; per-fold LOTO residualization identical 0.0323/0.0645 — all far below vote 0.4516.
stage2_carry_forwards: Include probe24+knn25 within-task rank-average as a cheap latent steelman arm in the 400-task re-confirmation.

Baseline-to-beat for Stage 2 is the no-latent votes+q_mean+vote_share union (pass@2 0.4839; 0.5161 with latent, which only TIES Stage-0's top-3-then-q_mean shortlist ceiling) — vote_share is a cheap feature worth keeping.
n=31 CI upper edge (+0.0645) cannot exclude a small positive: re-confirm the negative at 400-task scale.
corrigendum_2026_06_09.steelman_ceiling: Best latent construction found across ~300 swept variants: pass@2=0.4839 (+1 task; unbalanced ridge PCA-24 / probe_k192 / lda_k24 / probe24+knn25 rank-average all hit the same single-task ceiling, rescuing f3e62deb gold at vote-rank 2). Bootstrap CI95 [0.0, +0.0968] touches zero, post-hoc selected from 16-240 configs, and 0.4839 equals vote's own optimistic tie-break ceiling. 'Does not beat vote' holds at the sweep maximum too.
corrigendum_2026_06_09.vote_leak_mechanism: Per-candidate mean-pooling of z_H[:,0] over the candidate's `votes` augmentation views injects vote count into the feature (corr(||z_mean||, log1p(votes)) ~ -0.80 raw-norm, ~ -0.41 Spearman; ~ -0.014 after centering). Stage-2 design constraint: energies MUST be computed from grid content generator-independently with NO augmentation pooling.

honest_note: GAP-3 Stage 1. A POSITIVE that survives the residual control = the model-native energy works -> register it + re-confirm at 400 scale. A NEGATIVE = even the full latent can't beat vote on this corpus (deeper: the headroom may need a generator-INDEPENDENT trained ARC energy, Stage 2). Reported as-is per FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK; positive control = oracle > vote (real headroom). CAVEAT n~31 + 512-d latent over ~31 LOTO folds overfits easily; PCA-K + L2 + balanced classes + OOF are the guards. Re-confirm at 400 before any irreversible claim.
no_oracle_audit: Gold output read ONLY to LABEL correctness; the probe is trained OUT-OF-FOLD (LOTO) so a held-out task's gold never trains its own ranker; PCA basis fit on train folds only.
title: GAP-3 Stage 1: TRM penultimate-latent model-native selection energy vs frequency vote
vs_stage0: Stage 0 (scalar q_halt) did NOT beat vote (Q_MEAN pass@2 0.290; residual 0.097). Stage 1 tests whether the FULL un-collapsed latent (hidden-dim) recovers the signal the scalar lost.
